plugins.description: Skills: trov, load-context, record-session (orient→work→record), my-work, tickets, read-plan + update-plan (admin), handoff, prompts, artifacts — plus the auto-wired Trov MCP server. One connection covers every organization you belong to (it follows the repository you are in, or the organizations you pick). Connects by browser sign-in: run /mcp and choose Authenticate.
